newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KTT says exceptionals due to asset sale.
newsitem.headline: KTT says exceptionals due to asset sale.

text.p: Keppel Telecommunications & Transportation Ltd said on Tuesday the Singapore $3.15 million exceptional item in its 1996 financial results was due to an asset sale by a subsidiary.
"It was a gain from the disposal of office premises at Sindo Building held by Fulec Communications Pte Ltd," a company spokesman told Reuters.
"They have since shifted to a new building at Aljuneid Road," she added.
Keppel T&T, formerly known as Steamers Maritime Holdings Ltd, announced on Monday a 27.5 percent rise in net profit for year ended December 1996 to S$15.74 million on a turnover of S$176.70 million.
One analyst at a Wall Street company said Keppel T&T's earnings were actually flat and within expectations if the exceptional item was excluded.
The Estimate Directory predicted the company would post lower earnings of between S$12.90 to S$15.00 million.
On Tuesday, Keppel T&T shares were trading one cent higher, at S$1.55 on a turnover of about 1.6 million shares.
